scripts.dev: install-electron && GRAM_READABLE_BUNDLES=1 electron-vite build -c electron.vite.server.config.ts && GRAM_READABLE_BUNDLES=1 electron-vite build -c electron.vite.speech.config.ts && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.build: electron-vite build && electron-vite build -c electron.vite.server.config.ts && electron-vite build -c electron.vite.speech.config.ts && node ../../tools/notices/generate.mjs
scripts.dist: bun run --filter @gram/web build && bun run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: bun run --filter @gram/web build && bun run build && electron-builder --dir --publish never
